1. Objective: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records associated with the enzyme CYP2D6, including structural details for the substrate compound and names for the parent compound.

2. Output: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name

3. Source: metabolism, compound_records (as substrate), compound_structures, molecule_dictionary (as parent), docs

4. Logic: Filter metabolism records where enzyme_name equals 'CYP2D6'. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain the substrate compound name. Join compound_records to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join metabolism to molecule_dictionary on drug_record_id to retrieve the parent compound name. Join metabolism to docs on drug_record_id to link the parent compound to its source document. Sort the results by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name in ascending order. Limit the output to 200 rows.
